parrafo_1.es: All-N-1 Precise Catering es un negocio local de West Palm Beach, FL que opera desde una cocina comercial licenciada en S Dixie Hwy, inspeccionada y aprobada por sanidad. Preparan y entregan pedidos para bodas, eventos privados y almuerzos corporativos.
parrafo_1.en: All-N-1 Precise Catering is a local West Palm Beach, FL business operating from a licensed commercial kitchen on S Dixie Hwy, inspected and approved by the health department. They prepare and deliver orders for weddings, private events and corporate lunches.

parrafo_2.es: 18 resenas en Google con 4.8 de calificacion respaldan el trabajo: comida fresca, entregas puntuales y disposicion para adaptar el menu a restricciones alimentarias.
parrafo_2.en: 18 reviews on Google with a 4.8 rating back up the work: fresh food, on-time deliveries and a willingness to adjust the menu for dietary restrictions.

texto.es: Cuentanos la fecha, el numero de invitados y el tipo de evento: boda, fiesta privada u oficina.
texto.en: Tell us the date, the guest count and the type of event: wedding, private party or office.

texto.es: Armamos un menu segun tu presupuesto y adaptamos platos para alergias o restricciones alimentarias.
texto.en: We build a menu around your budget and adjust dishes for allergies or dietary restrictions.

texto.es: Cada bandeja se prepara el mismo dia en nuestra cocina comercial de West Palm Beach.
texto.en: Every tray is prepared the same day in our West Palm Beach commercial kitchen.

texto.es: Llegamos a tu evento con la comida caliente y lista para servir, a la hora acordada.
texto.en: We arrive at your event with the food hot and ready to serve, right on schedule.

nota.es: Cada evento se cotiza segun el menu y el numero de invitados. Llamanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every event is quoted based on the menu and guest count. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Menus completos para bodas y celebraciones privadas, servidos con atencion al detalle de principio a fin.
texto.en: Full menus for weddings and private celebrations, served with attention to detail from start to finish.

texto.es: Bandejas individuales de desayuno y almuerzo entregadas a tiempo para tu equipo de oficina.
texto.en: Individually packed breakfast and lunch trays delivered on time for your office team.

texto.es: Servicio de buffet o entrega directa para fiestas, reuniones familiares y celebraciones de cualquier tamano.
texto.en: Buffet setup or direct drop-off for parties, family gatherings and celebrations of any size.

texto.es: Adaptamos platos a alergias, vegetarianos y otras restricciones sin perder sabor ni presentacion.
texto.en: We adjust dishes for allergies, vegetarian guests and other dietary restrictions without losing flavor or presentation.

pie.es: No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llamanos y confirmamos si podemos ayudarte.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Call us and we will confirm whether we can help.

items.quote: Nothing but great things to say about them!! First off the food was amazing some of the best food iv had in a long time. The service was great really made you feel welcomed and left you wanting to order again. I wouldn't change a thing about this catering company wonderful experience will defiantly be ordering again.
The food and attention to service and detail was phenomenal, very willing to adjust to any allergy or dietary restrictions as well
The food is always fresh and delivered on time. The quality is excellent along with the choices. Highly recommended.
